title: StepCode models.json

$schema.description: Editor reference for this file, for example "./models.schema.json" beside the file.

baseUrl.description: Endpoint base URL, for example http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1.

apiKey.description: Credential or a reference to one: a literal key, `$ENV_VAR`, or `!command`. A keyless local server still needs a placeholder value to appear in `/model`.

headers.description: Headers sent with every request to this provider.

authHeader.description: Send the credential as an Authorization header (default true for most dialects).

id.description: Model id as the endpoint expects it in the request body.

api.description: Request dialect for this model, overriding the provider: "openai-completions", "openai-responses", or "anthropic-messages".

baseUrl.description: Endpoint for this model only; overrides the provider.

reasoning.description: The model exposes a thinking/reasoning channel.

thinkingLevelMap.description: Maps a Step thinking level onto the value this model expects. Omitted levels use the provider default.

input.description: Modalities this model accepts: "text" and/or "image". Defaults to text only.

cacheRead.description: USD per million cached input tokens read back.

cacheWrite.description: USD per million tokens written to the prompt cache.

inputTokensAbove.description: Input token count above which this tier's rates apply.

items.description: One pricing tier for long-context requests.

tiers.description: Long-context pricing; the base rates apply below the first tier.

cost.description: Cost per million tokens, used for usage and cache-miss reporting. Not used for billing.

contextWindow.description: Context window in tokens (default 128000). Drives compaction.

samplingParams.description: Extra request fields, for example temperature, top_p, or a vendor-specific flag.

headers.description: Headers added to requests for this model.

items.description: One model served by a provider.

name.description: Display name overriding the built-in catalog.

reasoning.description: Whether the model exposes a thinking channel.

thinkingLevelMap.description: Maps a Step thinking level onto the value this model expects. Omitted levels use the provider default.

cacheRead.description: USD per million cached input tokens read back.

cacheWrite.description: USD per million tokens written to the cache.

inputTokensAbove.description: Input token count above which this tier's rates apply.

items.description: One pricing tier for long-context requests.

cost.description: Overrides for a built-in model's cost. Omitted rates keep the catalog value.

samplingParams.description: Extra request fields for this model.

headers.description: Headers added to requests for this model.

^.*$.description: Edits applied to a built-in model, keyed by model id under `modelOverrides`.

modelOverrides.description: Edits to built-in models, keyed by model id.

^.*$.description: One provider entry, keyed by the id used in `/model` and `--model provider/id`.

description: StepCode `models.json`: provider endpoints, credentials and model definitions. JSON with `//` comments is accepted. The global file is `~/.stepcode/models.json`.
